name: ZX_PRODUCT_OPTIONS_ALL
description: This table stores the tax system options for multiple applications. Each record stores tax options of a business unit for a specific application.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Application identifier

columns.name: DEF_OPTION_HIER_1_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate the first precedence for defauting tax classification code

columns.name: DEF_OPTION_HIER_2_CODE
columns.description: Code to indicate the second precedence for defauting  tax classification code

columns.name: DEF_OPTION_HIER_3_CODE
columns.description: Code to indicate the third precedence for defauting  tax classification code

columns.name: DEF_OPTION_HIER_4_CODE
columns.description: Code to indicate the fourth precedence for defauting  tax classification code

columns.name: DEF_OPTION_HIER_5_CODE
columns.description: Code to indicate the fifth precedence for defauting  tax classification code

columns.name: DEF_OPTION_HIER_6_CODE
columns.description: Code to indicate the sixth precedence for defauting  tax classification code

columns.name: TAX_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Tax classification code to be defualted if it is not obtained from any of the defaulting hierarchy precedences

columns.name: TAX_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Type of tax method used to determine taxes. Possible values are LTE and EBTAX.

columns.name: INCLUSIVE_TAX_USED_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if inclusive taxes are used for Latin Tax Engine

columns.name: TAX_USE_CUSTOMER_EXEMPT_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if customer exemptions are included when calculating taxes for transactions of this application and operating unit

columns.name: TAX_USE_PRODUCT_EXEMPT_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if item exemptions are included when calculating taxes for transactions of this application and operating unit

columns.name: TAX_USE_LOC_EXC_RATE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if the tax rate that was defined for specific products based on the customers ship-to address is used for transactions of this application and operating unit

columns.name: TAX_ALLOW_COMPOUND_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if compound taxes are calculated by Latin Tax Engine

columns.name: TAX_ROUNDING_RULE
columns.description: Tax rounding rule used by Latin Tax Engine

columns.name: TAX_PRECISION
columns.description: Precision used by Latin Tax Engine

columns.name: TAX_MINIMUM_ACCOUNTABLE_UNIT
columns.description: Minimum accountable unit used by Latin Tax Engine

columns.name: USE_TAX_CLASSIFICATION_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if the tax classification code is in use for this application and operating unit

columns.name: ALLOW_TAX_ROUNDING_OVRD_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether tax rounding override is allowed for Latin Tax Engine

columns.name: HOME_COUNTRY_DEFAULT_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether country code is to be defaulted when the country of location for this operating unit is same as bill to or ship to location

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether the record is migrated, seeded or defined by the user

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_MAPPING_ID
columns.description: Event class mapping identifier

columns.name: DEF_OPTION_HIER_7_CODE
columns.description: Code to indicate the seventh precedence for defauting  tax classification code

columns.name: PRODUCT_OPTIONS_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier

columns.name: SALES_TAX_GEOCODE
columns.description: State and local tax jurisdiction geocode for United States provided by Taxware for point of order acceptance location

columns.name: TAX_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency used to pay the tax authority and to report on all tax transactions.

columns.name: WHT_TAX_FLAG
columns.description: Type of tax in the product options. Possible values are I for indirect tax and W for withholding.
